Bras historique fige: orchestration autonome desactivee, ne prouve pas l'orchestration autonome. Conserve uniquement pour la comparabilite des pilotes passes; exclu de toute preuve confirmatoire. Les bras adaptatifs avec orchestration autonome sont definis dans les plans dedies (regime-change).
Baseline locale de routage explicite, sans framework externe (ni MaaS ni politique apprise).
Squelette reserve a une comparaison externe appariee : aucun framework concurrent execute a ce jour. L'adaptateur echoue ferme tant que externalFramework et externalProtocol ne sont pas renseignes.

externalProtocol.description: Protocole commun requis avant toute allegation de comparaison directe avec un systeme concurrent : memes taches, memes graines, memes budgets, oracle independant partage, execution reelle via le framework concurrent.
externalProtocol.adapterRegistration: Enregistrer un adaptateur external-paired avec externalFramework renseigne (ni none ni pending), externalProtocol renseigne, et execution reelle via le framework concurrent, sinon le garde assertExternalComparisonAllowed refuse l'allegation.

limitations: A randomized assignment schedule is not an experiment result.
No general causal superiority is established; the general comparison remains a pilot on four toy tasks.
All currently executable adapters are local configurations (provenance local-config, externalFramework none); no direct comparison with competing systems is established.
The bundled toy tasks are pilot fixtures and are not unseen or confirmatory holdout tasks.
The historical morphogenesis-historical-frozen arm runs with autonomous orchestration disabled and does not prove autonomous orchestration; it is excluded from confirmatory evidence.

Static adapted/wrong topology arms are executable via genos-full with frozen per-task topology (task.adaptedTopology/task.wrongTopology) and disabled adaptive selection; oracle-selection remains pending because training outcomes are absent.
GenOS internal tools are disabled by request; any observed tool use invalidates the task-condition fairness check.
GenOS arms share the same token/latency ceiling plus harness-scale calibration (minimumWorkerTokens, workerShare) required to fund workers; isolated workspace, capsule root and database per attempt.
